dirs.direction: Warm editorial: paper-textured serif headlines, ruled lines, and a hand-annotated weekly calendar like a printed planner
Dark utility terminal: near-black background, monospaced type, keyboard-shortcut hints, and a command-line-style week view
Tidal calm: layered teal-to-foam gradients, soft rounded cards, and a gentle inline-SVG wave motif evoking a shared pool of time
Swiss brutalist: a strict 12-column grid, oversized sans-serif type, hard black borders, and high-contrast primary color blocks
Dimensional product showcase: skeuomorphic card stacks and a large floating app mockup as the hero, with glossy highlights and depth

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Tidepool — Plan your week together</title>
<meta name="description" content="Tidepool helps small teams plan their week together, on one shared page that reads like a good printed planner.">
<style>
  /* ---------- Tokens ---------- */
  :root {
    --paper: #f4ecdc;
    --paper-deep: #ebe0c8;
    --card: #faf5ea;
    --ink: #2a2319;
    --ink-soft: #5e5240;
    --ink-faint: #9a8d74;
    --rule: rgba(42, 35, 25, 0.16);
    --rule-strong: rgba(42, 35, 25, 0.42);
    --terracotta: #b4522e;
    --sage: #5f7257;
    --mustard: #e9c25f;
    --plum: #6e3e52;

    --serif-display: "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Palatino, "Book Antiqua", Georgia, serif;
    --serif-text: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
    --hand: "Bradley Hand", "Segoe Print", "Comic Sans MS", "Chalkboard SE", cursive;
    --sans: "Avenir Next", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;

    --measure: 1120px;
  }

  /* ---------- Base ---------- */
  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }

  html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

  body {
    margin: 0;
    font-family: var(--serif-text);
    font-size: 18px;
    line-height: 1.6;
    color: var(--ink);
    background-color: var(--paper);
    background-image:
      radial-gradient(ellipse at 12% 8%, rgba(255, 252, 240, 0.7), transparent 45%),
      radial-gradient(ellipse at 88% 30%, rgba(255, 252, 240, 0.5), transparent 40%),
      radial-gradient(ellipse at 40% 90%, rgba(180, 150, 100, 0.10), transparent 50%),
      radial-gradient(rgba(120, 95, 60, 0.07) 1px, transparent 1px),
      radial-gradient(rgba(120, 95, 60, 0.05) 1px, transparent 1px);
    background-size: auto, auto, auto, 3px 3px, 7px 7px;
    background-position: 0 0, 0 0, 0 0, 0 0, 1px 2px;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    min-height: 100vh;
  }

  img, svg { display: block; max-width: 100%; }
  a { color: inherit; }
  p { margin: 0 0 1em; }

  .wrap {
    width: min(100% - 48px, var(--measure));
    margin-inline: auto;
  }

  .eyebrow {
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: 0.72rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.18em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    margin: 0 0 14px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
  }
  .eyebrow::after {
    content: "";
    flex: 1;
    height: 1px;
    background: var(--rule-strong);
    max-width: 120px;
  }

  h1, h2, h3 {
    font-family: var(--serif-display);
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    line-height: 1.05;
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--ink);
  }

  .display-xl {
    font-size: clamp(3rem, 7.4vw, 6.1rem);
    font-weight: 400;
    letter-spacing: -0.025em;
  }
  .display-l {
    font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 4.6vw, 3.6rem);
    font-weight: 400;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  }
  .display-m { font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1.2; }

  em.ital {
    font-style: italic;
    color: var(--terracotta);
  }

  .lede {
    font-size: 1.22rem;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    max-width: 34em;
  }

  .hand {
    font-family: var(--hand);
    color: var(--plum);
    font-size: 1.05rem;
    line-height: 1.2;
  }

  .sans-small {
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
  }

  /* ---------- Buttons & links ---------- */
  .btn {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.01em;
    padding: 14px 22px;
    border-radius: 2px;
    border: 1.5px solid var(--ink);
    background: var(--ink);
    color: var(--paper);
    text-decoration: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: transform .15s ease, background .15s ease, color .15s ease;
    box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--mustard);
  }
  .btn:hover { transform: translate(-1px, -1px); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--mustard); }
  .btn:active { transform: translate(1px, 1px); box-shadow: 1px 1px 0 var(--mustard); }

  .btn--ghost {
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--ink);
    box-shadow: none;
  }
  .btn--ghost:hover { background: rgba(42,35,25,0.05); box-shadow: none; transform: none; }

  .text-link {
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    color: var(--ink);
    text-decoration: none;
    border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--terracotta);
    padding-bottom: 2px;
  }
  .text-link:hover { color: var(--terracotta); }

  /* ---------- Masthead / nav ---------- */
  .masthead {
    border-bottom: 3px double var(--rule-strong);
    padding: 18px 0 14px;
  }
  .masthead__top {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: 0.78rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    padding-bottom: 12px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
    gap: 16px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  .masthead__row {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 24px;
    padding-top: 14px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  .logo {
    font-family: var(--serif-display);
    font-size: 2rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    text-decoration: none;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
  }
  .logo__mark {
    width: 30px;
    height: 30px;
    flex: none;
  }
  .nav {
    display: flex;
    gap: 28px;
    align-items: center;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  .nav a {
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    text-decoration: none;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
  }
  .nav a:hover { color: var(--ink); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--terracotta); text-underline-offset: 4px; }

  /* ---------- Hero ---------- */
  .hero {
    padding: 72px 0 56px;
    position: relative;
  }
  .hero__grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1.15fr 0.85fr;
    gap: 56px;
    align-items: start;
  }
  .hero h1 { margin-bottom: 26px; }
  .hero__ctas {
    display: flex;
    gap: 22px;
    align-items: center;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    margin-top: 34px;
  }
  .hero__note {
    margin-top: 22px;
    font-family: var(--hand);
    font-size: 1.1rem;
    color: var(--plum);
    transform: rotate(-1.5deg);
    display: inline-block;
  }

  /* Dateline + issue box */
  .issue-box {
    border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
    background: var(--card);
    padding: 22px 24px 20px;
    position: relative;
    box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.6) inset, 6px 6px 0 -1px rgba(42,35,25,0.08);
  }
  .issue-box::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    top: -10px; left: 50%;
    width: 110px; height: 22px;
    transform: translateX(-50%) rotate(-2deg);
    background: rgba(233, 194, 95, 0.55);
    box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.05);
  }
  .issue-box h3 {
    font-size: 1.35rem;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
  }
  .issue-box ul {
    list-style: none;
    padding: 0;
    margin: 14px 0 0;
  }
  .issue-box li {
    display: flex;
    gap: 12px;
    padding: 11px 0;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
    font-size: 1rem;
    line-height: 1.4;
  }
  .issue-box li:first-child { border-top: 0; }
  .issue-box .num {
    font-family: var(--serif-display);
    font-style: italic;
    color: var(--terracotta);
    min-width: 1.5em;
  }
  .issue-box .sans-small { margin-top: 10px; }

  /* ---------- Calendar (the signature piece) ---------- */
  .planner-section { padding: 40px 0 96px; }

  .planner {
    position: relative;
    background: var(--card);
    border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
    padding: 0 0 28px;
    box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.7) inset, 10px 12px 0 -2px rgba(42,35,25,.07);
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .planner__head {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: baseline;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 12px 24px;
    padding: 26px 32px 18px;
    border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ink);
    position: relative;
  }
  .planner__title {
    font-family: var(--serif-display);
    font-size: 2.2rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  }
  .planner__title i { color: var(--terracotta); font-weight: 400; }
  .planner__meta {
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    display: flex;
    gap: 22px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .planner__body {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 170px repeat(5, 1fr) 1fr;
    position: relative;
  }
  /* weekend column is slightly shaded */
  .day {
    border-right: 1px solid var(--rule);
    min-height: 330px;
    padding: 14px 14px 16px;
    position: relative;
    background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 0 33px, var(--rule) 33px 34px);
    background-position: 0 58px;
  }
  .day:last-child { border-right: 0; }
  .day--weekend { background-color: rgba(233, 194, 95, 0.07); }

  .day__head {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink);
    padding-bottom: 8px;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
    background: none;
  }
  .day__name {
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: 0.72rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.16em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
  }
  .day__num {
    font-family: var(--serif-display);
    font-size: 2rem;
    line-height: 1;
    font-weight: 400;
  }
  .day--today .day__num { color: var(--terracotta); }
  .day--today .day__num::after {
    content: "";
    display: block;
    width: 44px; height: 44px;
    border: 2px solid var(--terracotta);
    border-radius: 50%;
    position: absolute;
    margin-top: -40px;
    margin-left: -10px;
    transform: rotate(-6deg) scaleX(1.08);
    border-radius: 48% 52% 45% 55% / 55% 45% 55% 45%;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .entry {
    font-family: var(--serif-text);
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    line-height: 33px;
    color: var(--ink);
    display: flex;
    align-items: baseline;
    gap: 8px;
    margin: 0;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
  }
  .entry__time {
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    min-width: 40px;
  }
  .entry--tag-sage .entry__dot { background: var(--sage); }
  .entry--tag-terra .entry__dot { background: var(--terracotta); }
  .entry--tag-plum .entry__dot { background: var(--plum); }
  .entry--tag-mustard .entry__dot { background: var(--mustard); }
  .entry__dot {
    width: 8px; height: 8px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    flex: none;
    align-self: center;
  }
  .entry--done { color: var(--ink-faint); text-decoration: line-through; text-decoration-color: var(--terracotta); }

  .entry--highlight {
    background: linear-gradient(transparent 40%, rgba(233,194,95,.55) 40%, rgba(233,194,95,.55) 92%, transparent 92%);
    margin-left: -4px;
    padding-left: 4px;
  }

  /* Sidebar column: people */
  .people {
    border-right: 1px solid var(--rule);
    padding: 14px 16px 16px;
    background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 0 33px, var(--rule) 33px 34px);
    background-position: 0 58px;
  }
  .people__label {
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: 0.72rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.16em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink);
    padding-bottom: 8px;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
    min-height: 52px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-end;
  }
  .person {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    font-family: var(--serif-text);
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    line-height: 33px;
    height: 33px;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .avatar {
    width: 24px; height: 24px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: 0.65rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--paper);
    flex: none;
  }

  /* Hand annotations */
  .note {
    position: absolute;
    font-family: var(--hand);
    color: var(--plum);
    font-size: 1.02rem;
    line-height: 1.15;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 3;
  }
  .note--sticky {
    background: #fbf1b8;
    padding: 12px 14px 14px;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 0 rgba(42,35,25,.12), 4px 6px 12px rgba(42,35,25,.10);
    width: 190px;
    color: #4a3440;
  }
  .note--sticky::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    left: 50%; top: -9px;
    width: 64px; height: 18px;
    transform: translateX(-50%) rotate(-3deg);
    background: rgba(233,194,95,.75);
  }
  .note--margin { color: var(--terracotta); }
  .note svg.arrow {
    position: absolute;
    overflow: visible;
    stroke: var(--terracotta);
    fill: none;
    stroke-width: 1.8;
    stroke-linecap: round;
    stroke-linejoin: round;
  }

  .planner__footer {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 16px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    padding: 16px 32px 0;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
    margin-top: 0;
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
  }
  .legend { display: flex; gap: 18px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .legend span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; }
  .legend i { width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; display: inline-block; }

  /* Circled ellipse around Thursday demo */
  .circle-mark {
    position: absolute;
    pointer-events: none;
    overflow: visible;
    stroke: var(--terracotta);
    fill: none;
    stroke-width: 2;
    stroke-linecap: round;
  }

  /* ---------- Ruled sections ---------- */
  .ruled-block {
    position: relative;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
  }

  .section { padding: 96px 0; }
  .section--tight { padding: 72px 0; }

  .section-head {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.6fr;
    gap: 40px;
    align-items: end;
    margin-bottom: 56px;
    padding-bottom: 28px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink);
  }
  .section-head h2 { font-size: clamp(2.1rem, 3.8vw, 3.1rem); }
  .section-head p { margin: 0; color: var(--ink-soft); max-width: 40em; }

  /* Features: ruled list */
  .features {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    border-top: 1px solid var(--ink);
  }
  .feature {
    padding: 34px 30px 40px 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
    position: relative;
  }
  .feature + .feature { padding-left: 30px; border-left: 1px solid var(--rule); }
  .feature:nth-child(3n+1) { padding-left: 0; }
  .feature:nth-child(n+4) { border-bottom: 0; }
  .feature__num {
    font-family: var(--serif-display);
    font-style: italic;
    color: var(--terracotta);
    font-size: 1.1rem;
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 18px;
  }
  .feature h3 {
    font-size: 1.6rem;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }
  .feature p {
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    font-size: 1.02rem;
    margin: 0;
  }
  .feature .hand {
    margin-top: 16px;
    font-size: 1rem;
  }

  /* How it works: ledger */
  .ledger {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0;
    counter-reset: step;
  }
  .step {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 120px 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 36px;
    padding: 36px 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
    align-items: start;
  }
  .step:first-child { border-top: 1px solid var(--ink); }
  .step__day {
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.16em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    padding-top: 10px;
  }
  .step__big {
    font-family: var(--serif-display);
    font-size: 4.2rem;
    line-height: 0.9;
    color: var(--ink);
    font-weight: 400;
    margin-top: 4px;
    display: block;
  }
  .step h3 { font-size: 1.9rem; margin-bottom: 10px; }
  .step p { color: var(--ink-soft); margin: 0; }
  .step__aside {
    border-left: 2px solid var(--mustard);
    padding: 4px 0 4px 20px;
    font-family: var(--hand);
    font-size: 1.12rem;
    color: var(--plum);
    line-height: 1.35;
    transform: rotate(-0.6deg);
  }

  /* Pull quote on paper deep */
  .pullquote-band {
    background: var(--paper-deep);
    background-image:
      repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 0 39px, rgba(42,35,25,.09) 39px 40px);
    padding: 80px 0;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
  }
  .pullquote {
    max-width: 860px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    text-align: left;
    position: relative;
    padding-left: 0;
  }
  .pullquote blockquote {
    margin: 0;
    font-family: var(--serif-display);
    font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 3.4vw, 2.7rem);
    line-height: 1.22;
    font-weight: 400;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    color: var(--ink);
  }
  .pullquote blockquote em { color: var(--terracotta); }
  .pullquote cite {
    display: block;
    margin-top: 28px;
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-style: normal;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
  }
  .pullquote .mark {
    position: absolute;
    top: -36px;
    left: -10px;
    font-family: var(--serif-display);
    font-size: 6rem;
    line-height: 1;
    color: var(--terracotta);
    opacity: .5;
  }

  /* Three-column small list (team sizes / principles) */
  .principles {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 0 64px;
  }
  .principle {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 44px 1fr;
    gap: 6px 14px;
    padding: 26px 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  }
  .principle__mark {
    font-family: var(--serif-display);
    font-style: italic;
    font-size: 1.6rem;
    color: var(--sage);
    line-height: 1;
  }
  .principle h3 { font-size: 1.4rem; margin-bottom: 6px; }
  .principle p { grid-column: 2; margin: 0; color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 1rem; }

  /* Pricing */
  .pricing {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 0;
    border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
    background: var(--card);
  }
  .tier {
    padding: 36px 32px 34px;
    border-right: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
  }
  .tier:last-child { border-right: 0; }
  .tier--feature { background: #fff9ec; }
  .tier__name {
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.16em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    margin-bottom: 14px;
  }
  .tier__price {
    font-family: var(--serif-display);
    font-size: 3.4rem;
    line-height: 1;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  }
  .tier__price small {
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    letter-spacing: 0;
    margin-left: 4px;
  }
  .tier__desc { color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 1rem; padding-bottom: 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); margin-bottom: 20px; }
  .tier ul { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0 0 28px; flex: 1; }
  .tier li {
    position: relative;
    padding: 7px 0 7px 28px;
    font-size: 1rem;
    line-height: 1.4;
  }
  .tier li::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    left: 0; top: 11px;
    width: 14px; height: 14px;
    border: 1.5px solid var(--ink);
    border-radius: 2px;
    background: transparent;
  }

        <article class="feature">
